statement.zh: Petrie 与 Quibell 以《Naqada and Ballas》(1896) 正式报告 1894–95 年纳卡达与巴拉斯前王朝墓地发掘，该批材料是 Naqada 序列类型学的历史基石之一。
statement.en: Petrie and Quibell published the 1894–95 Naqada and Ballas Predynastic cemetery excavations in Naqada and Ballas (1896), a historical cornerstone for the Naqada ceramic/sequence typology.
